why_agent_cannot: connect a wallet and approve the signature
what_human_must_do: Connect a burner wallet and approve the signature yourself.
steps_from_source: Open the Dow XP page and connect an EVM wallet. BNB Chain is Dow's main network.
Connect your X account, then publish a post about Dow and submit it for review.
Link Telegram and Discord from the same quest list.
Once your post is approved, share your referral link.
Before depositing, read the vault terms , including the auto-roll deadline.
